answer: Like pressurized shale crystallizing over eons, peer trust condenses through recursive stake-weighted attestations. A diffuse nebula of false identities fractures against this bedrock, where validation weight grows non-linearly. To simulate consensus, an adversary must pledge quadratic collateral, imposing a superlinear attacker cost that swallows rogue actors into a sable abyss of forfeited stake before they can sway the network.
